stem: What was the purpose of the Pure Food and Drugs Act of 1906?

options.label: F
options.text: To protect consumers by regulating the food and drug industry

options.label: G
options.text: To lower the cost of essential foods and drugs for consumers

options.label: H
options.text: To prevent shortages by regulating the supply of food and drugs

options.label: J
options.text: To reduce production costs for food and drug manufacturers

visual_elements:
What was the purpose of the Pure Food and Drugs Act of 1906?

F  To protect consumers by regulating the food and drug industry

G  To lower the cost of essential foods and drugs for consumers

H  To prevent shortages by regulating the supply of food and drugs

J  To reduce production costs for food and drug manufacturers
